releaseNotes: BOOX text options are now shown in a persistent LuMa panel instead of a briefly flashing popup
Text blocks get a large E-Ink friendly resize handle in Text mode
Text blocks automatically grow vertically while typing when content exceeds the current height
Text is no longer clipped when switching to Pen or Marker; non-Text modes expand blocks to show all content
Text content, formatting, size and position remain persisted across tool changes and reloads
No new APK is required; Shell 1.1.0 remains sufficient
